item.title: A Cowboy Life: Jaylon Smith, A Clear Eye View
item.description: Jaylon Smith grew up on the south side of Fort Wayne, Indiana, there were plenty of opportunities to fall to the dark side but a big, tight family and sports kept him on the right path…that and an uncanny focus to be something special. Enjoy #9, Jaylon Smiths story - A Clear Eye View

item.title: A Cowboy Life: Romo to Witten…Touchdown! Part 1
item.description: Tony Romo is a former Dallas Cowboys Quarterback. During his 14 seasons in the NFL, he led the Cowboys through a tumultuous series of leadership changes, draft picks, playoff games, and more. But Tony Romo didn't do it alone. He had help, from a Tight End named Jason Witten.

item.title: A Cowboy Life: Romo to Witten…Touchdown! Part 2
item.description: This week on A Cowboy Life, Tony shares his story about the man who helped shape the quarterback we know today, and ultimately, began to shape the Dallas Cowboys.

item.title: A Cowboy Life: Jourdan Lewis
item.description: Growing up in Detroit, Lewis's love for the game of football began at an elementary age. The love and support of his family took Lewis from Cass Technical High School all the way to The University of Michigan. In this episode, Jourdan sits with Brady to explain how a unique bond with his family helped get him to the NFL.
